environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with default configuration. No rate limiting rules configured on the ALB listener. Security groups allow inbound HTTPS from 0.0.0.0/0. The /api/v1/auth/* endpoints are publicly accessible. No AWS WAF association on the ALB. ECS task role has minimal permissions (ECR pull, CloudWatch logs). RDS PostgreSQL backend with no connection throttling.

config.application: no per-endpoint rate limiting configured in Spring Security
